verdict.rationale: Rollbar docs confirm that data retention periods can be customized on paid plans, giving some retention control, but there is no evidence of explicit data-deletion controls (e.g., APIs or UI to purge specific records) or granular deletion policies suited to AI-native compliance needs. missing for 10: explicit deletion/purge controls, evidence of GDPR/CCPA-style data erasure workflow, independent confirmation of retention enforcement.
